answer: Require every agent to post a bond that can be slashed when a randomly selected, delayed audit finds fabricated work or collusion. Audits sample claims across a long horizon, so an attacker cannot cheaply predict which identities will be checked; rewards accrue only after a claim survives review. Spinning up a nebula of sybil accounts therefore multiplies the capital locked at risk, while splitting one bond across identities weakens each account’s influence. Honest agents earn nectar from verified contributions, not mere headcount.
